newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran price index up in 11 months to mid-February.
newsitem.headline: Iran price index up in 11 months to mid-February.

text.p: The average price index of goods and consumer services in Iran climbed 23.8 percent to reach 455.7 points in the 11 months ending in mid-February of 1997, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Sunday.
It also quoted the Central Bank's economic statistics department as saying the average retail price index of goods rose 26.1 percent to 602.4 points over the same period.
